## Appearance

Stella Maynard is described as a vivid individual. She possesses striking black eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Stella Maynard is an ambitious and imaginative student at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), recognized as part of a close circle of friends. She is described as thoughtful and is notably referred to as a "rose-red" girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- thoughtful, imaginative, ambitious  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where she formed a close friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). As final examinations approached in the spring, she gathered with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends to discuss their academic anxieties, hopes for the future, and upcoming commencement clothes. Stella completed her time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her friends as they reached the end of their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P9](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV.
